# Copilot Instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first. Personas are cataloged in
[`.github/AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) and routed by [`docs/agent-routing.md`](../docs/agent-routing.md).

- Never claim automated, browser, provider, deployed, or human evidence that was not actually collected.
- Destructive, production, external write, publication, and credential actions require explicit human authority.
